other_failure_modes.name: Improper missing value handling before string conversion
other_failure_modes.description: Converting a column to string before handling missing values causes NaNs to be converted to the literal string 'nan', which corrupts derived text features like string length or word count.

summary: The agent successfully implements a LightGBM regression model with 5-fold cross-validation and extracts features from text using TF-IDF and SVD. However, fitting the TF-IDF vectorizer and SVD on the concatenated train and test data causes severe data leakage. Additionally, a minor bug in string conversion causes missing values to be processed as the literal string 'nan'.
